I like ABC kitchen and ABCV but I really didn't think ABC Cocina is as good as the other two restaurants. Tacos were not flavorful. Portions are small so you have to order a lot. The interior looks nice tho.

Really fantastic experience! 

Food - are mostly small plates to share. The ingredients are fresh, thoughtfully seasoned and put together - nothing is overly greasy. I would say that the prices do add up as each item is fairly small.

Drinks - were lovely. The mezcal negroni I got was delicious.

Service - was thoughtful and efficient. The servers clearly knew what they were doing and made sure we had a great time.

Went here recently with my husband, the ambiance was great and all the tapas/small plates were great to share. I highly recommend the calamari and the beef empanada. Probably one of the best churros and chocolate I have had since visiting Spain. 
The cocktail list is extensive and creative.

I went for restaurant week and had a pretty disappointing experience. The service was not welcoming and we had to ask multiple times for water. Our drinks arrived after our first course only after we followed up about the status. The food was fine but nothing exciting, the empanada appetizer was boring and the strawberry dessert was too sweet. I'll be sticking with ABCV going forward.

Got here early.... And this is what I really liked... I know it may sound a little lame, buuuuut the thinly sliced squash salad w shaved parm and arugula was soooo delightful! Light, tangy, savory, refreshing...I thought the portion was small,....maybe it wasn't but I wanted triple.... It's very good, I tilted the plate and drank the citrusy dressing. I have no manners. The fish tartare was good....nothing outstanding.... Same goes for the ham and queso croquetas. The patatas bravas were so bravas... I feel like it's bravas for a reason. It was lackluster. The empanadas were good...had a nice corn filling and I think they were fried...it was good... the crunchy fish taco wasn't as crunch as I wanted it.
Overall flavor and texture were a 7/10. The only thing that stood out was the summer salad. $18 bux for patatas bravas is rough. Service on the other hand is lovely and very attentive. Drinks are strong.
Very nice place. We went for the guest chef from Columbia and food was amazing not to mention service. I definitely want to go back for their regular menu.

good food. Fancy environment. 
The mushroom is terrific. Seafood are really fresh. 
A good restaurant. Price is ok considering the food quality.

Incredible! New favorite spot in the city. I wish I gave this place a chance sooner. Every dish here was an absolute hit. From the summer squash quesadilla, the chicken tacos, hearts of palm salad to even something as simple as the guac. Everything was incredibly delicious and well made. The margaritas on the other hand, spectacular. They come in so many different flavors. Perfect for a group dinner or event too. I've been here 2 times since and cannot wait to go back again.

Amazing service and excellent food. We stopped here for tasting menu. You get a ton of food including homemade guacamole, calamari, tartare, salad, chicken and rice and fish tacos plus dessert. I also got a concord grape margarita. Everything was delicious.but the tartare missed the mark flavorwise. Still excellent choice.

Great place for brunch. The dining area has an eclectic vibe. The food is delicious. We are family style so we could taste more dishes. The fish tacos had a nice blend of textures and sauce. There's a chance it could finish spicy. That was a nice mystery. The steak with chimmichurri was great. Finished it with the churros which was fun. They surprised us with a birthday salted caramel ice cream for someone's birthday. Very nice touch.

As others have pointed out, it's overpriced for what you get. chicken and rice for +$34? 1 little taco for $13?  Spacing is kind've cramped. People constantly hitting my chair as they walk by. Drinks were good tho. Wouldn't come back.

We had a great dinner at ABC Cocina last night. All the food was delicious including the guac, patatas bravas, fluke crudo, hearts of palm salad and tacos. We also loved the speciality margaritas and the churros for dessert. The meal was a little spendy but at least you get what you pay for unlike many other overpriced restaurants in NYC these days.
The food was incredible! I went there twice in one week. My favs were the arroz con pollo, grilled octopus and smash burger. We had the churros for dessert and it was the best churros I've ever had.

First time dining at ABC Cocina, and the first impression started off a little shaky.  My friend and I had a 530pm reservation and walked in and stepped to the side because the host was taking care of a couple of people who had just arrived before we did. 
So, while we were waiting for her to finish, a three people group came up on the other side to wait as well. So after she finished taking care of the people before us, she turned to the three group party and asked how can she helped them. 
Now, this is when my mind begins to wonder. I know she saw us come in and  step to side, waiting.
The other group wasn't even there when we arrived. Graciously, the older white lady in the group said to her (host), I believe they were here before us waiting.
I let her know we had reservations, and while she checked, I turned to the lady and said, "Thank you."
Now, in that moment, we looked at each other, and  both understood without saying a word. What had just happened. 
So as she takes us to our table, she sits us next to two gentlemen in the right-hand corner. So now, I'm thinking all these tables are free, why sit us here. Maybe the seating is based on the number of people from reservations. 
Also, the seat was shaky as well as the table. I let my waitress know, and she took the seat away and fixed the table. 
Now, from this point on, everything was excellent.
The servers here were amazing, attentive, polite, and friendly. We had at least 5 to 6 servers back and forth at our table, making sure everything was ok with food, water, and drinks. 
My rankings from what we had beef tacos#1. It was the best tasting beef I ever had in a taco, amazing. #2 calamari, perfectly seasoned crispy skin outside and tender inside with the tasty pickled onions and sauce. #3 chicken tacos perfectly seasoned crispy skin outside, tender inside and flavorful. I would like maybe something else added in taco, like the beef one.
#4 the mushrooms, never had these types of mushrooms before. Great flavor and nice texture with the cheese added and their hot sauce on the the table put this dish over the top. 
#5 Spring pea empanada was different but tasted good, hot, and cheesy. #6 guacamole was fresh and tasted good. I never had guacamole made this way before, and chips were crisp. #7 Heart of Palm Salad was good and fresh. Just could have been a little more on the plate. 
I had one fresh beet juice, and we also had a few basil margaritas. Overall, the food, drinks, servers, and the two gentlemen we sat next to made our experience delightful and fun.

We ordered the tasting menu based on how it was advertised online. Turns out they took off two of the dishes and still charge the same price, which we didn't realize until the end of the meal. Additionally, the drink I ordered upon sitting down never arrived, which I flagged after the second course. After the fourth course, I was brought a drink that wasn't what I ordered without being asked if that was something I enjoy. Just dropped it on the table and walked away. No apology and very little effort to make it right. Will not be returning.

We just happen to pass by this place and it looks so enticing. We had a glass of wine at the bar and it's quite pleasant. The place has a romantic ambiance. Lighting is a bit dark but charming. The bartenders are very nice. We had a great time and it's not very noisy at 5pm. Would love to come back and try the food.

Came here for a late dinner after seeing Titanique the Musical, at 9 PM on a Tuesday, and was surprised to find it packed and loud inside. The decor is beautiful and the ambiance is really cool, but after spending a few minutes inside we asked for a table outside so we could hear each other speak without shouting. This was perfect for us. Service was slow, but we didn't mind. 

We shared a bunch of tapas: patatas bravas, spiced ground beef and celery root empanadas with tomato salsa, wood fired octopus with green romesco sauce, and crispy gulf flounder tacos with a cabbage chili pickle topping. For dessert, we ordered churros with chocolate dipping sauce. The food was plated beautifully and tasted amazing, but my favorite dish of the night were the spiced ground beef empanadas.

This is an excellent place to get cocktails/drinks and tapas or smaller plates. Their fritters were amazing (especially with the sauce) and their sangria was also very good. Attentive service and very cool interior decor (it is also connected to ABC Cafe and other restaurants so it might be confusing if you are dropped off by an Uber because ABC Cocina is on the 18th side but ABC Cafe is on the 19th side). Recommended!
Popped in for a cocktail and some bar food. Yummy on both counts with lovely service.

Came here for restaurant week and it was SO good. Every single thing I ate here was good. 

I ordered the fluke, the Hake, and the churros. 

The fluke was well seasoned and flavored, although I would remove the corn because texturally it was too tough. I felt like I was going to chip a tooth eating it. But it was good either way. 

The Hake was seriously sooo good, flavorful, and flaky. It was done to absolute perfection. Would highly recommend this dish. 

Lastly I ordered the churros as my dessert and it was good, can't go wrong with this!

Ambiance, service, food were all excellent.

I would say a solid 3.5/5. Good food and nice setting. It can get pretty loud but nice for sharing plates and catching up with friends.

I got the sweet corn empanadas and the passionfruit margarita and thoroughly enjoyed both. It was hard to track down our server to order more drinks and grab the bill, hence the bit of the lower rating. It also felt a touch overpriced but that is NYC for ya.

I went to ABC Cocina for a dinner with a group and we had a lovely time. The ambiance is beautiful and the service is very friendly. The fish tacos were delicious, i am still thinking about them! A little pricey, but it's very nice!
Amazing staff, good, and atmosphere. Unique menu, knowable and friendly servers, and good vibes.

This was our farewell dinner in New York City, and it was so worth the price of admission! It was expensive, but so great! Each dish is savory and well prepared and the presentation is esthetically pleasing and artistic. Our server was wonderful.  My favorite dish was the guacamole because it was unique and cheese free. I also loved the ceviche and the octopus. A+++
All I can say is amazing ! My only recommendation is that if you have a party of two, it would be better to have four pieces of an entrée as opposed to three.

This place has be around a long time and is a NYC dining institution which has unfortunately slid a bit over the past few years. A most recent dinner at ABC Cocina with some girlfriends had me wondering why we spent $18 per cocktail on the drinks which sound and taste delicious but feel like they have a very minimal amount of actual alcohol in them (no one in the group felt even a hint of a buzz after having two cocktails each). The tapas dishes are very small so you have to keep ordering and ordering as the bill keeps growing and your belly is somehow not filling. Among the tapas there's hits and misses. The service is consistently good though despite it being a very loud and busy restaurant. Honestly I'll probably keep going because it's an easy meetup spot but will grumble about it afterwards.

It's a very expensive restaurant, and from the start, they rush you, taking your plate away before you've finished--it seems very rude to me. After traveling to so many countries, I believe that in New York, you're expected to eat quickly; there's no respect for the customer. It wasn't even full.
I strongly disagree.

Great food, great drinks, great vibe, great desserts and super friendly and quick service. 
I got the diablo which is a spicy drink and I thought it was very well made. 
They have a tapas style menu so I got to try a bunch of things - 
Guacamole: simple, fresh with warm just-out-of-the-fryer chips 
Yellowfin tartare: had a lot of different elements that really brought the dish together, although wasn't my favorite thing on the menu
Squash and cheese emanada: on the sweeter side, but not greasy or doughy
Mushroom quesadilla: was pleasantly surprised with this one. I'm used to eating quesadillas that tend to be very greasy and cheesy and although this had a great amount of cheese, it still felt pretty easy on the stomach 
Fish tacos: one of the most interesting tacos I've had, it hit all the flavor profiles - had some sweetness, freshness and spice 
Hopper shrimp: simple and amazing! 
Salted caramel gelato: the best ending to our meal

Overall, I felt that the food was wonderful, everything felt really fresh and light which I loved. I really felt like I was eating high quality food for a relatively average-priced NYC restaurant. Our server was also excellent. Would love to come back here.

Wow! This place was amazing. The food was delicious, the service was great and I would definitely come back. Our wait staff Lindy, Ines and were amazing and made us feel very welcomed!!  The churros are to die for!  It's a must try!!
